## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`, `project(dtkmultimedia)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
```

The top-level script has no `install()` rule, so build artifacts stay in `build/`.

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 34 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `debhelper-compat (= 12)`
- `cmake`
- `pkg-config`
- `qt6-5compat-dev | libqt5x11extras5-dev`
- `qt6-base-dev | qtbase5-dev`
- `qt6-base-private-dev | qtbase5-private-dev`
- `qt6-tools-dev-tools | qttools5-dev-tools`
- `qt6-tools-dev | qttools5-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 3 packages with `find_package`: `QT`, `Qt`, `Doxygen`.
